description: Canonical ABAP Cloud rewrite per readiness category: the typical classic pattern and its released-equivalent shape. Curated by hand; examples are illustrative skeletons, not drop-in code.

list-output.pattern: WRITE / ULINE / SKIP classic list output
list-output.after: APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) TO rt_result. " expose rt_result via a RAP service
list-output.notes: Return data instead of printing it: a RAP BO / OData service for UIs, if_oo_adt_classrun's out->write( ) for console runs, the application log (if_bali_log) for diagnostics.

dynpro.after: " no statement-level equivalent: model the entity as a RAP BO (scaffold_rap_bo) and rebuild the screen as a Fiori elements app on its OData service
dynpro.notes: Dynpro work is re-architecture, not substitution — one screen usually maps to one RAP BO with draft handling replacing the old PAI/PBO state.

report-events.before:
PARAMETERS p_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
START-OF-SELECTION.
  PERFORM main USING p_carrid.
report-events.after:
CLASS zcl_flight_run DEFINITION ... INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main. " importing parameters become method params / filter values
    run( carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
report-events.notes: Selection screens become RAP filter parameters (for services) or application-job parameters (for batch); the event block's logic moves into a class method.

report-program.before:
REPORT zflight_sync.
...
SUBMIT zflight_cleanup AND RETURN.
report-program.after: CLASS zcl_flight_sync DEFINITION ... INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun. " SUBMIT chain -> application jobs or bgPF units calling the next class
report-program.notes: Executables become classes (if_oo_adt_classrun for utilities). SUBMIT has no released equivalent — re-orchestrate chains as application jobs or bgPF.

native-sql.before:
EXEC SQL.
  SELECT carrid INTO :lv_carrid FROM zflight WHERE connid = :lv_connid
ENDEXEC.
native-sql.after: SELECT SINGLE carrid FROM zflight WHERE connid = @lv_connid INTO @lv_carrid.
native-sql.notes: Rewrite as ABAP SQL; keep genuinely database-specific logic (hints, window tricks) inside a released AMDP method instead.

rfc.pattern: CALL FUNCTION ... DESTINATION / STARTING NEW TASK
rfc.before: CALL FUNCTION 'Z_RECALC' STARTING NEW TASK lv_task.
rfc.after:
" async unit of work via background Processing Framework:
DATA(lo_process) = cl_bgmc_process_factory=>get_default( )->create( ).
lo_process->set_operation_tx_uncontrolled( NEW zcl_recalc_bgpf( ) )->save_for_execution( ).
rfc.notes: bgPF replaces fire-and-forget tasks inside one system; cross-system calls go over released HTTP/OData communication arrangements, not raw RFC.

subroutines.before:
PERFORM calc_total USING lv_in CHANGING lv_out.
FORM calc_total USING iv_in TYPE i CHANGING cv_out TYPE i.
  cv_out = iv_in * 2.
ENDFORM.
subroutines.after:
lv_out = calc_total( lv_in ).
METHOD calc_total. " importing iv_in, returning rv_out — in a (local) class
  rv_out = iv_in * 2.
ENDMETHOD.
subroutines.notes: Purely mechanical: each FORM becomes a method (local class of the same program/class); USING/CHANGING become typed importing/returning parameters.

transaction-glue.before:
SET PARAMETER ID 'CAR' FIELD lv_carrid.
CALL TRANSACTION 'ZFLIGHT_DISPLAY'.
transaction-glue.after: " navigate via the app, not the transaction: expose the entity through a RAP service and use Fiori intent-based navigation (semantic object + action)
transaction-glue.notes: Transaction and SPA/GPA memory glue is UI-era coupling; the released pattern is intent-based navigation between Fiori apps over RAP services.

other.notes: No single recipe: open each finding's docsUrl and substitute the released equivalent; check_released_api tells you the successor for object references.
